spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache && cd /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier && python3 eval_majority_voting.py --base_model_path /root/.cache/huggingface/hub/Qwen/Qwen3-4B --checkpoint_path checkpoints/best --data_dir data/ --output eval_majority_voting.json --K 3 --temperature 0.7 --gpu 0"

experiment_data.hypothesis: Per-test majority voting (K=3, temperature=0.7) with fine-tuned 4B classification model 能否通过 self-consistency 提升 single-pass 87.5% accuracy
experiment_data.notes: Majority voting K=3 (temperature=0.7) 无效，accuracy 从 87.51% 降至 86.83% (-0.69pp)。93.3% 样本三次预测一致（unanimous），仅 127 个分歧样本中 28 个被错误翻转 vs 15 个被正确翻转（net -13）。模型错误是系统性偏差而非随机噪声，voting 无法修复。推理时间从 30s 增至 120s (4x)，无收益。结论：single-pass greedy 是最优推理策略，majority voting 不值得采用。
